notes:
Tidying up the Go to hymn screen.

**The Clear key no longer runs onto two lines.** It was being drawn in capitals, which made it too wide for the key, so the last letter wrapped underneath and knocked the bottom row of the keypad out of line.

**Go, Close and More now match the buttons in every other window.** They were being given the boxed look used for the tools down the side of the page, which belongs on the page rather than in a dialogue.

Your library, annotations and licence are not affected.
